email.subject: Blue Pipe Plumbing: a couple quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I took a look at Blue Pipe Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no way to book or request service online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next plumber, and the pages load slowly because the images are too heavy, which pushes mobile visitors away before they even see your number.

Both are fixable without a redesign. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
